changes.audio: CSC complete-exercise player replaces the standalone consigne player. It uses the same narrated plan as the ZIP: instruction, example beep, two announced listens, beeps, letters for numbers/calculations, five-second question intervals and no calculation result. Individual players remain available. No silent fallback to an instruction-free download.
changes.score: The introductory CSC sentence is fixed at 100 points even after editing question weights; scoring weights and other test domains remain independent.
changes.problemGrid: Enabled by default on screen, optional per problem. CSC problem quadrillage is always hidden in print CSS; white answer-zone frames and corrected workings remain.

checks.coverage: 100 seeds, operand/operator/operand narration without result, two listens and timing, fixed CSC announcement with varied score inputs, other domains preserved.

pdf.visualReview: Actual problem PDF page inspected: white frames, no internal grid, response lines and page margins preserved.

limitations.historicalFullBrowser: The broad historical tcm-csc-browser.mjs scenario stops at its square-number-grid assertion. Number-grid geometry rules are unchanged by this patch. No full-suite pass is claimed; requested audio/score/problem behavior is covered by the focused real-browser/PDF scenario.

privacy: Only locally generated example worksheets used; no saved-fiche deletion or Worker deployment.
